name: BlinklinkFeed
summary: Blinklink server-driven short-form video feed SDK for iOS.
description:
Short-form video feeds rendered natively and driven by the server:
the Frontline Feed screen (search, filters, banner, video grid),
embeddable referrer feeds (carousel / 3D carousel / grid), and a
vertical shorts player with likes, share links, CTAs, offline caching,
and built-in analytics. Layouts and settings update from the Blinklink
portal with no app release.
